inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL upsert treats each incoming nullable field as a partial patch: IF(non-null incoming value, incoming value, existing column) preserves omitted values on duplicate keys while still inserting complete new rows.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a two-profile settings patch. One multi-row upsert changes only selected non-NULL fields on an existing profile, preserves NULL-patched fields, and inserts a new profile; the source schema, identifiers, parameters, and analysis data are not copied.

fixture_notes: Profile 701 keeps its display name and digest frequency while receiving a timezone patch and a disabled-notifications patch. Profile 702 is inserted by the same upsert.
determinism_notes: Profile IDs, nullable patch values, existing defaults, and final primary-key ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE profile_settings (profile_id INT PRIMARY KEY, display_name VARCHAR(32) NULL, timezone_name VARCHAR(32) NULL, digest_frequency VARCHAR(16) NULL, notifications_enabled TINYINT NULL)

steps.sql: INSERT INTO profile_settings (profile_id, display_name, timezone_name, digest_frequency, notifications_enabled) VALUES (701, NULL, 'Asia/Tokyo', NULL, 0), (702, 'Fern', 'America/New_York', 'weekly', 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE display_name = IF(VALUES(display_name) IS NOT NULL, VALUES(display_name), profile_settings.display_name), timezone_name = IF(VALUES(timezone_name) IS NOT NULL, VALUES(timezone_name), profile_settings.timezone_name), digest_frequency = IF(VALUES(digest_frequency) IS NOT NULL, VALUES(digest_frequency), profile_settings.digest_frequency), notifications_enabled = IF(VALUES(notifications_enabled) IS NOT NULL, VALUES(notifications_enabled), profile_settings.notifications_enabled)
SELECT profile_id, display_name, timezone_name, digest_frequency, notifications_enabled FROM profile_settings ORDER BY profile_id
